name: Chicken Infested

index.description_snippet: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. Chickens turn up whenever you reach for your gear.

description_html: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. Chickens turn up whenever you reach for your gear.
description_text: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. Chickens turn up whenever you reach for your gear.
prerequisite_html: 1st-level commoner only. Like other flaws, this can be taken only at 1st level, and each flaw grants a bonus feat.
prerequisite_text: 1st-level commoner only. Like other flaws, this can be taken only at 1st level, and each flaw grants a bonus feat.
benefit_html: Each time you draw a weapon or take an item out of a container, there is a 50% chance you produce a live chicken instead.
benefit_text: Each time you draw a weapon or take an item out of a container, there is a 50% chance you produce a live chicken instead.

name: Peasant Hat

index.description_snippet: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. You will not be seen without a peasant hat.

description_html: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. You will not be seen without a peasant hat.
description_text: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. You will not be seen without a peasant hat.
prerequisite_html: 1st-level commoner only. Like other flaws, this can be taken only at 1st level, and each flaw grants a bonus feat.
prerequisite_text: 1st-level commoner only. Like other flaws, this can be taken only at 1st level, and each flaw grants a bonus feat.
benefit_html: You take a -15 penalty on Diplomacy checks. Other characters in your party can cast command on you once per day, and you get no saving throw.

name: Pig Bond

index.description_snippet: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. You are stuck hauling a pig that will not walk.

description_html: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. You are stuck hauling a pig that will not walk.
description_text: Joke flaw from Flaws for Commoners. You are stuck hauling a pig that will not walk.
prerequisite_html: 1st-level commoner only. Like other flaws, this can be taken only at 1st level, and each flaw grants a bonus feat.
prerequisite_text: 1st-level commoner only. Like other flaws, this can be taken only at 1st level, and each flaw grants a bonus feat.
benefit_html: You must carry a pig whose weight equals your maximum load. It will not move on its own. If your Strength changes, the pig's weight changes to match your new maximum load.
benefit_text: You must carry a pig whose weight equals your maximum load. It will not move on its own. If your Strength changes, the pig's weight changes to match your new maximum load.
special_html: If more than a few inches separate you from the pig, it turns into Orcus and kills you.
special_text: If more than a few inches separate you from the pig, it turns into Orcus and kills you.
